from pathlib import Path
base=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference/play/users/u028/system/state/workspace/programs')
base.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
p=base/'task-e6f41a31.py'
source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    border = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 5]
    top, bottom = min(r for r, c in border), max(r for r, c in border)
    left, right = min(c for r, c in border), max(c for r, c in border)
    markers = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row)
               if v not in (0, 5)]
    colors = {}
    for r, c, color in markers:
        qr = 0 if r < top else 1
        qc = 0 if c < left else 1
        colors[(qr, qc)] = color
    # Each marker colors its quadrant and the diagonally opposite quadrant.
    quadrants = {(0, 0): (top + 1, left + 1), (0, 1): (top + 1, right - 1),
                 (1, 0): (bottom - 1, left + 1), (1, 1): (bottom - 1, right - 1)}
    for (qr, qc), color in colors.items():
        # Fill the indicated 2x2 quadrant and its diagonal counterpart.
        for r in range(top + 1, bottom):
            for c in range(left + 1, right):
                if (r < (top + bottom) / 2) == (qr == 0) and (c < (left + right) / 2) == (qc == 0):
                    out[r][c] = color
                if (r < (top + bottom) / 2) == (qr == 1) and (c < (left + right) / 2) == (qc == 1):
                    out[r][c] = color
    return out
'''
p.write_text(source)
print(p.read_text())
